description: RCBB SETS ITS FOOTPRINTS ON AFRICA! The flag exchange was done by Rtn Pooja Sharma and spouse Dinesh Sharma by stopping on the way back from an interesting trek to Mt. Kilimanjaro and doing a flag exchange with the RC of Moshi, Tanzania - a Club that works incessantly towards upliftment and gets support from RCs all over the World.
